title: Deion Sanders explains why Shedeur didn't hire an agent

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deion Sanders explains why Shedeur didn't hire an agent
sources.description: In a revealing and wide-ranging interview with Garrett Bush's The Barbershop, Colorado coach Deion Sanders opened up about the struggles his son, Shedeur, endured before and during the 2025 draft, when he fell all the way to the fifth round.
